overview: 2026 is F1's biggest regulation overhaul since 2022. New power units with massively increased electric power, active aerodynamics that adjust automatically, and lighter cars. The goal: better racing, more overtaking, sustainable fuel.

aerodynamics.activeAero: Both front and rear wings actively adjust angle during the lap. Reduces drag on straights automatically, increases downforce in corners automatically. Replaces the manual DRS system entirely.
aerodynamics.downforce: Overall downforce reduced approximately 30% vs 2025 to compensate for more powerful electric deployment on straights
aerodynamics.groundEffect: Retained and refined from 2022 regulations — cars still generate significant downforce from the floor
aerodynamics.width: Cars narrower than 2025 — improved wheel to wheel racing and reduced dirty air effect on following cars
aerodynamics.drs: Traditional DRS abolished — replaced by active aero system that is always optimizing

powerUnit.combustion: 1.6L V6 turbo hybrid — retained from previous era but heavily revised internals
powerUnit.electricMGUK: 350kW output from MGU-K — nearly 3x more than 2025's 120kW. Massive boost especially out of slow corners
powerUnit.MGUH: Completely removed — simplified hybrid system. Energy recovery now only from braking via MGU-K
powerUnit.fuel: 100% sustainable fuel mandatory — F1's green milestone
powerUnit.deployment: More aggressive electric deployment especially out of slow corners. Battery management becomes a critical strategic tool
powerUnit.split: 50/50 split between combustion and electric power — unprecedented in F1 history

chassis.weight: Minimum weight reduced approximately 30kg vs 2025 — back to proper racing car proportions
chassis.dimensions: Narrower and shorter than 2025 cars — more nimble, better driver feel
chassis.cockpit: Improved safety structures retained from previous regulations

tyres.supplier: Pirelli — new compounds designed for 2026 lighter cars
tyres.compounds: Revised compounds to handle different thermal loads from new power units

impact: Lighter cars + nearly 3x more electric power = dramatically faster acceleration. Active aero = less dirty air = better following and overtaking. 50/50 power split = new strategic dimension. Should be the most exciting regulation change since 2022.
